teaser: Seven drafts of the same email, still unsent, still being rephrased on the walk to work. That is the shape of life path 7 meeting an INTP, and what is particular here is not the hunger for solitude — plenty of numbers want quiet — but how little any single answer satisfies it for long. The 7 asks for a mind that keeps circling the mystery until it understands it; the INTP was built for exactly that kind of circling, taking a question apart and setting the pieces out on the table rather than putting it down. Neither one rests on conclusions for long; the question under the one that seemed settled last week gets sharpened instead, not closed.
excerpt: Eleven at night, after choir practice, and the ride home is quiet except for one half-formed theory about why the altos kept rushing the third verse — spoken aloud, mostly to work it out, not meant as conversation.
